Dervenakia-G3.title_original: Τεχνική Περιγραφή — Οδικό τμήμα Δερβενάκια (Περιφέρεια Πελοποννήσου), Γέφυρα Γ3, «Τυπική διατομή γέφυρας»
geometry_notes: Precast pretensioned doble-T girder, L = 39.0 m, 6 per span at 2.40 m (text p35). Midspan section only; the 1.50-2.00 m solid rectangular end zones are excluded.

Chain 0.15 + 0.10 + 1.61 + 0.26 + 0.28 = 2.40 closes. Convention (reading of a 1112 px raster figure): the '.10' is the flange-tip thickness and '.15' the flange thickness at the start of the 0.30 x 0.10 haunch, so the underside slopes from (0.70, H-0.10) to (0.45, H-0.15); the haunch meets the 0.30 web at H-0.25.
Bottom: 0.90 flange with 0.28 vertical edge and 0.26 splay to the 0.30 web.

Strymonas-study.title_original: Διερεύνηση της σεισμικής απόκρισης γέφυρας με βάθρο θεμελιωμένο σε ρευστοποιήσιμο έδαφος (διπλωματική εργασία, Ε. Ελευθερίου, ΕΜΠ 2020), Σχήμα 9 «Διατομή δοκού»
Strymonas-study.organisation: National Technical University of Athens (NTUA), supervisor I. Psycharis
Strymonas-study.source_status: academic thesis (2020) modelling a real Strymonas-area bridge; build status of this exact girder not verified

printed_m.bottom_dims_0_25: 0.25 from each web face (extension lines, see notes)

geometry_notes: Midspan section of the 40.5 m variable-section precast prestressed girder (7 per 42 m span). The 0.90-wide end block and the tapered transition (Σχήμα 8) are excluded.
The bottom splay is drawn from the web to the flange edge (0.325 horizontal); the two '0.25' dimensions end on extension lines inside the splay and are not flange-edge positions.
The earlier registry described this beam as asymmetric; Σχήμα 9 is symmetric.
Whole-deck composite properties (Πίνακας 7: Atot 9.20 m2, Iy 6.41 m4) are not per-beam and are not used.
